source_or_gap: The ASI Stack already owns compressed-artifact admission, residual honesty, fast generation, resource accounting, readiness, formal refinement, and derivative custody, but it does not yet join them through a representation-invariant functional precision contract, complete executable bit accounting, progressive precision field, compiler lifecycle, and scoped certificate.
chapter_action_policy: Integrate the paper into the eight existing owners, with RankFold/NeuralFold as the primary lifecycle owner and Compact Generative Systems as the residual representation owner. Preserve a standalone functional-precision chapter only as a post-integration contingency; do not create a path, manifest row, proof target, or active candidate during the structural freeze.
merge_or_split_policy: Merge functional rate-distortion, canonicalization, complete description accounting, compiler lifecycle, and certification into RankFold/NeuralFold; base/residual precision into Compact Generative Systems; route policy into Fast Generation; physical and assurance cost into Resource Economics; status and revocation into Readiness; refinement obligations into Executable Specifications; derivative closure into Model-Weight Custody; and precision-as-resource into the Efficient ASI Hypothesis.
boundary_decision_rationale: The paper supplies a coherent cross-chapter contract but not a currently unowned lifecycle. The compressed-artifact admission lease, residual representation, runtime routing, cost, certification, proof, and custody responsibilities already have explicit owners. A standalone chapter becomes warranted only if the completed integrations cannot preserve the compiler and certificate lifecycle without duplication or fragmentation.
